name: Otni
title: Temple Gatekeeper
summary: Otni was a Levite from the family of Korah, son of Shemaiah and grandson of Obed-Edom. He served as a gatekeeper at God's house in Jerusalem during King David's reign. He is mentioned in the genealogy of Levitical gatekeepers in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of gatekeepers
keyEvents.description: Otni is listed as one of the sons of Shemaiah, son of Obed-Edom, among the Levitical gatekeepers appointed for service at the temple.

keyEvents.title: The family of Obed-Edom as gatekeepers
keyEvents.description: Obed-Edom's descendants were appointed as gatekeepers and were known as capable men fit for service.

keyEvents.title: Organization of the Gatekeeper Service
keyEvents.description: King David organized the gatekeeper service at the sanctuary, where the Levites were assigned in shifts to guard the gates of the Lord's house.

keyEvents.title: Shemaiah's Sons Described as Capable Men
keyEvents.description: Shemaiah's sons, including Othni, were described as capable men with great strength, and in total there were 62 capable men from Obed-Edom's family.
